doc: One waterfront building to build: its type, size, how far below its ground the water lies, and the season.

fields.name: theme
fields.doc: The village theme: its architecture and fires (heartland keeps the type's own).

fields.name: condition
fields.doc: Intact, or a ruin: broken down, roofless, overgrown, without its moving parts or lit fires.

fields.name: size
fields.doc: Its lot: small (rect3x4), medium (rect4x5), or large (rect5x6); the back two rows are land, the rest water.

fields.name: drop
fields.doc: How far below the lot's ground the water's surface lies, metres.
